# Congressional sourced brief — original Meri skill

Identity: quick_skill.bill_watch, version 1.0.0. This original artifact recipe is one bill-watch output; it does not replace the full bill-watch workflow or qualify its source adapters.

The Claude Agent SDK remains the model loop. Select this exact recipe and manifest before asking the typed compiler to prepare a brief. Keep Congress, session, canonical bill ID, exact bill version, fiscal year, budget stage and UTC as-of time explicit. Never silently select the latest version or equate authorization with appropriation.

Use the permission-aware gateway for decisive source reads. Candidate results, search snippets, remembered wording and URLs are locators. They cannot verify a fact. Quote exact read text with source ID, record ID, immutable source version and character range. The trusted compiler binds that text to canonical evidence hashes, source timestamps, applied scope and current authorization decisions. Source authenticity depends on qualified gateway adapters; hashes alone are not authenticity.

Separate read excerpts from free-form claims and proposed language. Free-form claims always require human verification, including when they have citations. Proposed language is a draft for review, never enacted text. Disclose unavailable, stale, missing, partial and conflicting evidence; do not infer absence from incomplete coverage. Retain coverage, continuation and a visible verification appendix in the editable DOCX.

Use the existing create_word request and document create/revise/inspect/download routes. Revision requires the exact immutable baseVersionId and retained spec hash. Preserve the original, its evidence and recipe pins. A new run must not silently upgrade an old recipe or change its legislative/budget basis. Inspect exact downloads, reopen DOCX bytes, render every page and visually inspect every page before source publication. Filing and external sharing require their separate authority.

Source connectivity and production handlers remain disabled until separately qualified. This recipe never starts another model loop, changes Temporal durability, grants permissions, creates tasks or sends messages.
